page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Margin notes in the left margin: "Cubitus" beside the paragraph on the cubit, and "Vlna" beside the paragraph on the ulna. Running head at top centre, page number at top left. Catchword and gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.p: Appendix est superioris capitis, vel inferioris.
Illa superiori capiti adnata, cartilaginea crusta oblita, in scapulæ acetabulum inseritur.
Hæc inferiori capiti adnata secundum Columbum; (negante Galeno & Valesio.)
Processus duo sunt, ad utrumque latus inferioris partis, quibus hærent principia musculorum tendentium ad extremam manum.
CubitusCubitus est os inter humeri flexum & carpum in longum intercedens.
VlnaUlna est os cubiti maius, inferius ad latus parvi digiti porrectum à flexu ad carpum.
Ulnæ pars superior crassior est, in duos processus oblongos triangulares terminata.
His processibus protuberantibus concluditur sinus Sigmoides, latinum C referens, quem processus isti comple-ctuntur, & circa illum vertuntur.
Hæc parte superiori articulatur cum humero per Ginglymon.

page.notes: The "Cubitus" and "Vlna" margin notes were read as plain marginal words; the small dagger-like marks beside them and after "manum" and "carpum" could not be read with certainty and are not marked in the text. "Ulnæ" in the italic heading is a doubtful reading ([?] not added because the vowel group is legible). The printed signature mark at the foot is read as "A" and the catchword as "fu-". Long s is rendered as plain s throughout, so "Proceffus", "procefsibus" and "comple-" are given as Processus, processibus and comple-ctuntur.
